title: Card - Plain
description: Flat, non-interactive card shell: canvas surface, card border, large radius, no shadow and no hover or focus lift. For informational cards that are not links (e.g. the service pages' icon card grid) — unlike Card - Feature / Card - Category, which add a shadow and a hover lift that wrongly signal clickability. Sits on a surface.card band; pair with a tinted icon well, an H3 and a paragraph. Entirely block-supports JSON, no SCSS.
